items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: this was a very famous conductor from Detroit, Michigan, Leroy Smith -- I don't know whether you ever heard of him

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

30s I happened to be living in Ohio at the time and there was a band that was on the road with Connie's Hot Chocolates and they had played in Pittsburgh and they had this engagement to play this dance in Akron, Ohio. The conductor came after the midnight show, I guess they had a substitute band for the last show because they had booked this dance and what was really interesting to me, I was still quite young, before the conductor came the orchestra consisted of bassoons, French horns, violins, the whole works and…
